test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fd6cf5ec6a274a9a602412f9de922b73e04ccf5eaf3f494d0ba78f2cce4880b.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The pattern in the every steps are 90 degree (towards right) shifts of pattern in the previous step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3b086742fb696771851bf0bac3dc907d0850220828dd541ef36f6636a34e85.png] The opening of the box moves 90 degrees right.

 ** The pattern moves anticlockwise.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87ffde51721c03dcc3ab94089a0e338563e7766fc161f0d7ffe94718991a0713.png] Here we can see that it moves anticlockwise.

Next step:

 **2 'U' will open towards left and the 'U' in the middle will open towards south east.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/494d078ba1b7fd8c7ae682106925cfa6953e0da57bad0996e5b275c057cd3a9f.png] 

Now we compare the given options:

Option 1) The 'U' in the left and right are positioned incorrectly.

Option 2) The 'U' in the middle is positioned incorrectly.

Option 3) The pattern is correct.

Option 4) The 'U' in the left is positioned incorrectly.

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
